scope_rule: Reviewed operation semantics and bounded native captures, not a complete service operation inventory or a support claim. The generated service inventory records the chosen-service operation target.

primary_revision.revision: AWS latest published documentation; API reference publication date recorded below, no immutable commit supplied

evidence_contract.observations: Ordered case/operation/parameters plus native code/output or error and HTTP/request ID when raw signed transport is used.
evidence_contract.secrets: Authorization tokens, passwords, credentials and presigned layer URLs are never retained. Upload IDs and digests are nonsecret.
evidence_contract.cleanup: Each capture retains owned resource names and observed deletion/not-found outcomes; KMS pending deletion is not immediate physical removal.

semantics: Repository identity includes account and region; URI must retain both scope dimensions.
Create fixes encryption; non-force deletion rejects nonempty repositories. Tags are resource tags, not image tags.
KMS repository creation validates same-region key and creates two grants; deletion retires them. KMS crypto uses aws:ecr:arn plus aws:s3:arn context; no parallel credential store.
Manifests and referenced blobs are real content-addressed bytes; tag rewrites must respect current repository mutability and exclusions.
PutImage may reject ImageAlreadyExists, ImageDigestDoesNotMatch, ImageTagAlreadyExists, LayersNotFound and ReferencedImagesNotFound.
Batch operations have per-image failures; deleting a tag differs from deleting a digest and all tags. Manifest-list references constrain deletion.
Token scope is the issuing IAM principal permissions, valid twelve hours; token is not a stored policy snapshot. Every registry HTTP request needs authentication.
Layer upload validates byte ranges and digest before completion. A download URL delivers actual bytes and must never be recorded as a fixture credential.
Private OCI/Docker HTTP push/pull is a separate real data plane, not merely API manifest metadata.
Current identity and repository policies compose; explicit deny wins. IAM must allow GetAuthorizationToken independently of repository grants.
Policy changes must affect existing token requests rather than only token issuance.
Evaluate all rules then apply priority; each image expires under zero or one rule. Higher-priority matching protects against lower-priority expiry.
Tag prefix/pattern lists use all-pattern matching against image tags; tagged selectors require patterns/prefixes. Count policies rank images by push time.
Preview is asynchronous; a retained policy is not proof of expiry execution. Native expiry may occur within twenty-four hours and is not synchronously forced by PutLifecyclePolicy.
Basic scanning consumes real OS/software inventory; unsupported image format/OS must not produce fake clean findings.
Basic manual scans are at most once per image per twenty-four hours; findings and status are asynchronous and completion emits EventBridge event.
Registry scanning settings are account/region control and are not modified by owned native probes. Enhanced Inspector-backed scanning is distinct.

Registry resource policy and replication configuration are registry-wide controls, not repository CRUD. Current AWS registry permissions documentation says registry policies are enforced for all ECR actions.
Replication requires actual eligible image bytes at authorized destinations; configuring rules alone is not successful replication. No standing registry defaults/policies changed by this probe.
Only images pushed or restored after replication configuration are eligible; preexisting images are not backfilled. Destination repository names stay unchanged and deletes are not propagated.

Cross-account permission is granted in the destination registry for ReplicateImage and optionally CreateRepository; source repository policies are not required. Removing a permission may let already-authorized in-progress replications complete.
Destination immutability can cause a replicated image to arrive without the colliding tag. Repository permissions/lifecycle/settings are not replicated by default.
